name: mcp-person-social-footprint-mapper
description: MCP server for Person Social Footprint Mapper. Find a person's public GitHub, Bluesky, personal site, Substack, and X profiles from their name and company domain, with a match confidence per platform. No emails or phones. Runs on Apify. Clay-ready output.

apify_token.title: Apify API Token
apify_token.description: Apify API token for running the actor

github_token.title: GitHub token (optional)
github_token.description: Your own free GitHub token, for larger batches

x_bearer_token.title: X API bearer token (optional)
x_bearer_token.description: Your own X API bearer token; without it X is skipped
